title: The Moon was placed or towed into position

tellings.quote: Is it an illusion? Was it put there? Tim insinuated that it was it wasn't there by accident. That it was set there.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, wonders aloud whether the Moon is quite what it seems. He says a man named Timothy Taylor hinted that the Moon did not end up where it is by accident, but was put there on purpose, which would mean someone placed it.
